title: Mechanical Design & Simulation
tagline: From Sketch to Simulation — Master 3D modeling, finite element analysis (FEA), and structural mechanics for modern engineering.
overview: This course bridges the gap between theoretical mechanics and industrial design. You will master 3D parametric modeling alongside advanced simulation techniques used in aerospace and automotive industries.

The curriculum focuses on Solid Mechanics, Finite Element Analysis (FEA), and Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD). You will learn to validate designs against real-world stresses, ensuring safety and performance-critical reliability.
learningOutcomes: Master parametric 3D modeling and assembly design
Perform linear and non-linear structural analysis (FEA)
Apply principles of Statics and Dynamics to digital prototypes
Execute thermal and fluid flow simulations (CFD)
Understand GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing) standards
Optimize designs for weight and material efficiency
Conduct failure analysis and fatigue testing on components

curriculum.title: Statics & Solid Mechanics
topics: Shear force and Bending moment diagrams

curriculum.title: Parametric 3D Modeling
topics: Sheet metal and surface modeling basics

curriculum.title: Finite Element Analysis (FEA)
topics: Introduction to meshing and element types
Static structural analysis and boundary conditions

curriculum.title: Mechanism & Dynamics
topics: Velocity and acceleration analysis in assemblies
Dynamic motion simulation and interference checking

curriculum.title: Advanced Simulation & CFD
topics: Fluid flow fundamentals in digital environments
Pressure drop and heat transfer optimization

curriculum.title: Project & Industrial Standards
topics: Exporting for 3D Printing and CNC machining
